paragraphs: R. Yudan Berabbi; see there. R. Elazar said: Yudan Berabbi expounded—Kiddushin 21b. In R. Berekhiah's name: Rabbah, Bechukkotai, end of section 36. Tanchuma, Reeh, has R. Yudah Berabbi; Jerusalem Avodah Zarah, chapter 2, R. Yudan son of Rabbi; see there, halakhah 1.
